name: Projectron
author: James McMurray
description: A Tron-style light-cycle duel: race around the arena leaving a trail behind you and make your rival crash first.

descriptions.en: A Tron-style light-cycle duel: race around the arena leaving a trail behind you and make your rival crash first.
descriptions.it: Un duello di moto di luce in stile Tron: corri nell'arena lasciando una scia dietro di te e fai schiantare l'avversario per primo.
